clues.text: This city grew along the banks of a calm river in the north east of Europe. Woods, lakes, and canals fill a full third of its land.
clues.narrowing: Rules out dry and sea side lands; puts the player by a river amid woods and lakes in the north east.

source.quote: Berlin was built along the banks of the Spree river, which flows into the Havel in the western borough of Spandau.

clues.text: Winters here bite with frost, yet summers turn warm, a bigger swing than most sea side lands. Stone streets store heat, so nights stay warmer in town.
clues.narrowing: Rules out even sea climates; the swing is wide, and the stone streets hold heat at night.

source.quote: Berlin's built-up area creates a microclimate, with heat stored by the city's buildings and pavement

clues.text: A wall split this city in two after a great war, and each half had its own rulers. In 1990 the halves joined, and it was a capital once more.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to a city split by a wall, then made whole and a capital again in 1990.

source.quote: Following German reunification in 1990, Berlin once again became the capital of all of Germany.

clues.text: In 1990, artists from 21 lands painted bright murals on a long stretch of the old wall. That painted wall still stands, and crowds come to walk beside it.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: a long stretch of the old wall still stands, covered in bright murals.

source.quote: In the spring of 1990, after the opening of the Berlin Wall, this section was painted by 118 artists from 21 countries.

clues.text: All of Germany is governed from this city, the seat of its national parliament. That role came back in 1990, when the split land joined as one.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: the national parliament sits here and the whole land is governed from here.

source.quote: Berlin is the capital and largest city of Germany.

reveal.blurb: Traders founded this city by a river crossing in the 1200s, and kings and emperors later ruled from it. After a war a wall split it in two, until the halves joined again in 1990. Artists then painted the wall that still stands. Berlin is the capital of Germany.
